items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 26 April 2026 at 5:20pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure covers Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

Mainly south or southeast 2 to 4, soon becoming variable for a time this evening, before settling north or northwest 2 to 4 overnight. Increasing 3 to 5 in the afternoon tomorrow.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with an increased risk of areas of mist and isolated fog patches soon developing this evening and overnight.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 3 to 5, veering east or northeast 3 to 5 overnight into Tuesday.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, still with a risk of mist and fog patches in places.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, falling poor in mist and very poor in fog patches.
